Reference evapotranspiration at weather stations

Source: R/prep-weather.R
ef_station_ref_et.Rd

Computes the reference evapotranspiration series of every station of a station table (hourly or daily records), and from it the two quantities that the METRIC chain needs: the instantaneous reference ET at given overpass times (etr_inst, mm h-1, for the cold anchor condition) and the daily reference ET of given dates (etr_24, mm d-1, for the extrapolation to 24 hours). It orchestrates the derived variables (ef_es(), ef_ea_rh(), ef_wind_2m(), ef_ra_period(), ef_rso(), ...) and the reference surface functions (ef_ref_net_radiation(), ef_ref_soil_heat_flux(), ef_ref_et()) on the values allowed by the quality control. The choices that are still open decisions of the specification (WF-09, WF-11, WF-15, WF-16) are explicit arguments without defaults.

Usage

ef_station_ref_et(
  x,
  reference,
  timestep,
  standard,
  humidity,
  day_definition,
  day_completeness,
  daytime_rule = NULL,
  night_cloudiness = NULL,
  night_ratio = NULL,
  overpass = NULL,
  inst_method = NULL,
  dates = NULL,
  utc_offset = NULL
)

Arguments

x

An earthflux_station_qc (ef_station_qc()) or an earthflux_station_table (ef_station_table()), which is then quality controlled with ef_station_qc(x) (policy "exclude_critical"; call ef_station_qc() first to choose another policy). Only the values whose QC status is not "excluded" are used; the excluded ones are missing.

reference

Character, no default. "alfalfa" (tall reference, ETr, the reference of METRIC) or "grass" (short reference, ETo). It must be the reference of the reference ET fraction of the cold anchor.

timestep

Character, no default. "hourly" (records with interval = 3600 s; FAO-56 Eq. 53 form) or "daily" (records with interval = 86400 s; FAO-56 Eq. 6 form). The records must be period means (timestamp_convention "end" or "start").

standard

Character, no default. "fao56" (grass only) or "asce" (ASCE-EWRI 2005 standardized equation), both VERIFICADA; see ef_ref_et(). It also selects the constants and limits of the net radiation (ef_ref_net_radiation()) and the treatment of sunrise and sunset in the hourly extraterrestrial radiation (ef_ra_period()).

humidity

Character, no default. Source of the actual vapour pressure: "vapour_pressure" (column vapour_pressure), "dewpoint_temperature" (FAO-56 Eq. 14 on dewpoint_temperature) or "relative_humidity" (hourly: FAO-56 Eq. 54 with air_temperature and relative_humidity; daily: Eq. 17 with tmin, tmax, rh_max and rh_min). The same forms are ASCE-EWRI (2005) Eqs. 8, 38, 41 and 11, ranked first or second in its Tables 3 and 4.

day_definition

Character, no default (decision WF-11). Day of the daily sums: "utc" (UTC calendar day) or "local_standard" (calendar day in the local standard time given by utc_offset, without daylight saving time). A period belongs to the day of its mid-point.

day_completeness

Character, no default (decision WF-11, gap policy). Only "all_periods" is implemented: a day has a daily value only if all its periods (24 hourly periods, or the daily record) have a valid reference ET; otherwise etr_24 is NA and flagged EF_WS_INCOMPLETE_DAY. No gap is filled.

daytime_rule

Character or NULL (decision WF-15). Hourly only (required; NULL for daily): criterion of the daytime periods, which select the soil heat flux ratio and, with standard = "asce", the denominator constant: "ra_positive" (extraterrestrial radiation of the period > 0; with standard = "fao56", sun above the horizon at the mid-point, FAO-56 midpoint criterion) or "rn_positive" (net radiation of the reference surface > 0, the definition of daytime of ASCE-EWRI 2005, text before Table 1 and Table 2, p. 5; see ef_ref_soil_heat_flux() for the inconsistency of the report at \(R_n = 0\)).

night_cloudiness

Character or NULL. Hourly only (required; NULL for daily): the cloudiness term of the periods where the ratio \(R_s/R_{so}\) is not used:

  • "before_sunset" (FAO-56, chapter 4, hourly time step): night-time periods (\(R_{so} = 0\)) take the term of the last period of the same station, in the previous 24 hours, whose mid-point hour angle lies in \([\omega_s - 0.79, \omega_s - 0.52]\), i.e. 2-3 hours before sunset;

  • "low_sun" (ASCE-EWRI 2005, Eq. 46, pp. 35-36): every period whose sun angle above the horizon at the mid-point (Eq. 62) is at most 0.3 rad (night, dusk and dawn, including periods with \(R_{so} > 0\)) takes the term of the last period of the same station, in the previous 24 hours, with a sun angle above 0.3 rad;

  • "fixed": night-time periods take the constant ratio night_ratio.

With "before_sunset" and "low_sun" the result is NA if there is no qualifying period or its term is missing (e.g. the first night of a series, or a season without any period of sun angle above 0.3 rad).

night_ratio

Numeric scalar or NULL. The night-time ratio \(R_s/R_{so}\) for night_cloudiness = "fixed", in [0, 1] for "fao56" and in [0.3, 1] for "asce" (FAO-56 suggests 0.4-0.6 in humid and sub-humid and 0.7-0.8 in arid and semi-arid climates; 0.3 means complete cloud cover; ASCE-EWRI, p. 36, allows a ratio from 0.3 to 1 where no period has a sun angle of 0.3 rad). NULL otherwise.

overpass

POSIXct or NULL. Overpass times at which the instantaneous reference ET is wanted (hourly only); converted to UTC. Every station gets every time.

inst_method

Character or NULL (decision WF-09). Required with overpass: "O1" (reference ET of the hourly period that contains the overpass time, start included, end excluded) or "O3" (linear interpolation in time of the hourly reference ET between the mid-points of consecutive periods; no interpolation across a missing record and no extrapolation). Options O2, O4 and O5 of the specification are not implemented.

dates

Date or NULL. Days of the daily sums (in the day definition). NULL: every day with at least one record, per station.

utc_offset

Numeric or NULL. Required with day_definition = "local_standard" (NULL otherwise): offset of the local standard time from UTC [h], in [-12, 14] (e.g. -4 for UTC-4), a single value for all stations or a vector named by station_id.

Value

An object of class earthflux_station_ref_et: a list with

  • series: one row per record of x$observations (same order) with station_id, timestamp, target_time (mid-point of the period, UTC), date (day of the period, see day_definition), extraterrestrial_radiation, clear_sky_radiation, solar_radiation (MJ m-2 per period: h-1 or d-1), vapour_pressure, vapour_pressure_deficit [kPa], wind_speed_2m [m s-1], cloudiness (the term \(1.35 R_s/R_{so} - 0.35\) used), cloudiness_source ("ratio", "before_sunset", "fixed"), daytime (hourly; NA for daily), net_radiation, soil_heat_flux (MJ m-2 per period) and et_ref (mm h-1 or mm d-1);

  • etr_inst: one row per station and overpass time with station_id, overpass_time (UTC), etr_inst [mm h-1] and method (zero rows without overpass);

  • etr_24: one row per station and day with station_id, date, n_periods (periods with a valid reference ET) and etr_24 [mm d-1];

  • reference, timestep, standard;

  • flags: earthflux_flag records of scope record for the codes that hold somewhere, each with an element target naming the table whose rows index refers to ("series", "etr_inst", "etr_24"): EF_INPUT_NA, EF_WS_RS_RSO_LIMITED and EF_WS_ETR_NEGATIVE (series), EF_WS_OVERPASS_OUTSIDE_RECORDS and EF_INPUT_NA (etr_inst), EF_WS_INCOMPLETE_DAY (etr_24);

  • provenance: the choices made, the verification status, the constants used, the QC policy and the values excluded by it, the provenance of the station table, flags_evaluated (and flags_evaluated_by_target) and the package version.

Details

Hourly records. For each record, with \(t\) the mid-point of the period: \(R_a\) of the period with ef_ra_period() (FAO-56 Eq. 28 or ASCE-EWRI Eq. 48; the treatment of sunrise and sunset follows standard; day of year of \(t\) in UTC), \(R_{so}\) with ef_rso() (Eq. 37, decision WF-12), the air pressure from the station elevation (ef_air_pressure(), Eq. 7, decision WF-05; a measured air_pressure is not used), \(\gamma\), \(e^\circ(T)\) and \(\Delta\) at the hourly temperature, the wind at 2 m from height_wind (Eq. 47), the solar radiation converted from W m-2 to MJ m-2 h-1 (x 0.0036, FAO-56 Table 3), then ef_ref_net_radiation(), ef_ref_soil_heat_flux() and ef_ref_et(). Periods with \(R_{so} > 0\) (with "low_sun": with a sun angle above 0.3 rad) use their own ratio \(R_s/R_{so}\) (limited to the range of the standard inside the cloudiness term and flagged EF_WS_RS_RSO_LIMITED); the others use night_cloudiness.

Daily records. Tmean = (Tmax + Tmin)/2 (Eq. 9), \(e_s\) = mean of \(e^\circ(T_{max})\) and \(e^\circ(T_{min})\) (Eq. 12), \(\Delta\) at Tmean, \(R_a\) with ef_ra_daily() (day of year of the record's day), the solar radiation converted from W m-2 (24-hour mean) to MJ m-2 d-1 (x 0.0864), \(G = 0\) (Eq. 42). A day with \(R_{so} = 0\) (polar night) has no defined cloudiness term and gives NA.

Daily sums (option D1 of the specification for hourly records, decision WF-16): etr_24 is the sum of the 24 hourly depths of the day (rate in mm h-1 times 1 h), negative values included; FAO-56 (chapter 4) states that hourly sums over 24 hours generally match the daily computation for the grass reference, and ASCE-EWRI (2005, p. 45) sums hourly ETos or ETrs over the 24-hour period and recommends retaining the negative values; neither source defines the clock of the day (UTC or local standard time, WF-11). Its use for METRIC (Allen et al., 2007) is TODO. For daily records etr_24 is the daily value of the record (option D2 with daily data).

Instantaneous reference ET (decision WF-09): etr_inst is a rate in mm h-1. An overpass time outside the time covered by the records of a station (option O1: from the start of its first period to the end of its last period; option O3: from its first to its last mid-point) gives NA and the flag EF_WS_OVERPASS_OUTSIDE_RECORDS; inside that range, a missing record or a missing reference ET gives NA and EF_INPUT_NA.

Values are never filled, truncated or corrected: negative reference ET is kept (EF_WS_ETR_NEGATIVE). Under qc_policy = "keep_all" an impossible value reaches the numeric functions, which raise earthflux_domain_error. Missing or unknown choices raise earthflux_missing_input or earthflux_unknown_method; choices that do not apply to the time step, a record interval that does not match timestep, or a missing column raise earthflux_input_error subclasses.

Verification status

The physics is that of the functions called (FAO-56 grass and ASCE-EWRI 2005 short and tall reference: VERIFICADA), reproduced through this function for FAO-56 examples 18 and 19. The orchestration choices are recorded in the provenance: "before_sunset" follows FAO-56 (chapter 4) with the selection of the last qualifying period as an implementation choice; "low_sun" (ASCE-EWRI Eq. 46) and "rn_positive" (ASCE-EWRI p. 5) are VERIFICADA; the day definition and the completeness rule are open decisions (WF-11); the daily sum is TODO for METRIC. The worked examples of ASCE-EWRI (2005), Appendix C, are not reproduced: the copy of the report that was read does not include the appendices.

References

Allen, R. G., Pereira, L. S., Raes, D., & Smith, M. (1998). Crop evapotranspiration: Guidelines for computing crop water requirements (FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56). FAO, Rome. ISBN 92-5-104219-5.

ASCE-EWRI (2005). The ASCE Standardized Reference Evapotranspiration Equation. Task Committee on Standardization of Reference Evapotranspiration, Environmental and Water Resources Institute of the American Society of Civil Engineers. Final report, January 2005. Published as Allen, R. G., Walter, I. A., Elliott, R. L., Howell, T. A., Itenfisu, D., Jensen, M. E., & Snyder, R. L. (Eds.), American Society of Civil Engineers, Reston, VA. doi:10.1061/9780784408056

See also

ef_station_table(), ef_station_qc().

Other reference evapotranspiration functions: ef_ref_et(), ef_ref_net_radiation(), ef_ref_soil_heat_flux()

Examples

# One synthetic station (fictitious values), 48 hourly records in UTC.
times <- as.POSIXct("2024-01-15 01:00", tz = "UTC") + 3600 * (0:47)
mid <- as.numeric(times) / 3600 - 0.5
sun <- pmax(0, cos((mid %% 24 - 16.8) * pi / 12))
st <- ef_station_table(
  stations = data.frame(station_id = "ST01", lon = -71.5, lat = -35.4,
                        elevation = 150, height_wind = 2,
                        height_temp_rh = 2),
  observations = data.frame(
    station_id = "ST01", timestamp = times,
    air_temperature = 14 + 12 * sun, relative_humidity = 80 - 45 * sun,
    wind_speed = 1 + 2 * sun, solar_radiation = 850 * sun
  ),
  provenance = list(timestamp_convention = "end", interval = 3600,
                    crs = "EPSG:4326")
)
et <- ef_station_ref_et(
  st, reference = "alfalfa", timestep = "hourly", standard = "asce",
  humidity = "relative_humidity", day_definition = "utc",
  day_completeness = "all_periods", daytime_rule = "rn_positive",
  night_cloudiness = "low_sun",
  overpass = as.POSIXct("2024-01-15 14:48", tz = "UTC"),
  inst_method = "O3"
)
et$etr_inst
#>   station_id       overpass_time  etr_inst method
#> 1       ST01 2024-01-15 14:48:00 0.6835366     O3
et$etr_24
#>   station_id       date n_periods   etr_24
#> 1       ST01 2024-01-15        13       NA
#> 2       ST01 2024-01-16        24 6.059376
